Package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.arg

Class RequestBeanSetters

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.arg.RequestBeanSetters
public final class RequestBeanSetters extends Object
Resolves and caches the public no-arg constructor and per-getter setter Methods for a concrete (non-interface) @Request bean class.

RequestBeanArg resolves one of these once, when the @RestOp is registered (servlet init), instead of the historical per-request Class.getMethod lookup in RestRequest.newRequestBean. A getter with no matching setter, or a bean with no public no-arg constructor, now fails registration with an IllegalArgumentException naming the bean, the getter and the expected setter — not only the requests that happen to supply that parameter.

Example:

// A concrete request bean: public no-arg constructor plus a setter for every annotated getter. @Request public class MyQuery { private String foo; @Query public String getFoo() { return foo; } public void setFoo(String value) { foo = value; } } RequestBeanMeta meta = RequestBeanMeta.create(MyQuery.class, annotations); RequestBeanSetters setters = RequestBeanSetters.resolve(MyQuery.class, meta); MyQuery bean = setters.newInstance(); setters.set(bean, meta.getProperty("getFoo").getGetter(), "value");

Since:
10.0.0

  • Method Details

    • resolve

      public static RequestBeanSetters resolve(Class<?> beanClass, RequestBeanMeta meta)
      Resolves the constructor and setters for a concrete @Request bean class.
      Parameters:
      beanClass - The bean class. Must not be an interface.
      meta - The metadata gathered from the class's annotated getters. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      A new RequestBeanSetters.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - If beanClass has no public no-arg constructor, or if any annotated getter has no matching setter.

    • set

      public void set(Object bean, Method getter, Object value) throws ReflectiveOperationException
      Invokes the setter matching the specified getter on the specified bean.
      Parameters:
      bean - The bean to populate. Must not be null.
      getter - The getter identifying the property, as returned by RequestBeanPropertyMeta.getGetter().
      value - The value to set. Callers skip absent (null) values rather than passing them here.
      Throws:
      ReflectiveOperationException - If the setter invocation fails.
